# A garden lantern on a short post: a dark iron frame round a glowing core (unlit). Up Z.
new
add mesh cube --name Post --size 1 --location 0 0 0.45
scale 0.1 0.1 0.9
apply --scale
material new Wood --base-color 0.467 0.361 0.310
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name Cap --size 1 --location 0 0 1.24
scale 0.22 0.22 0.08
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Base --size 1 --location 0 0 0.92
scale 0.28 0.28 0.06
apply --scale
material new Iron --base-color 0.184 0.129 0.231
select Cap Base
material assign Iron
add mesh cube --name Core --size 1 --location 0 0 1.07
scale 0.3 0.3 0.26
apply --scale
material new Glow --base-color 0.753 0.820 0.800
material assign Glow
select all
shade flat
export lantern.glb
